# Extract Audio from Video⁺

Extract Audio from Video⁺ is an iOS app that converts videos (MP4/MOV) on iPhone into high-quality MP3 or M4A audio files directly on the device.

## Main Sections

- [Landing page](/): App overview, features, how it works, FAQ, and links to the App Store.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy.html): How user data is handled across apps by Vladimir Ivakhnenko.
- [Terms of use](/terms.html): Terms that govern app usage and subscriptions.

- [All guides](/guides/): Step-by-step iPhone video-to-audio guides.

- [How to Convert MOV to MP3 on iPhone](/guides/mov-to-mp3-iphone/): Turn camera recordings into audio files.
- [How to Convert Video to M4A on iPhone](/guides/video-to-m4a-iphone/): Apple-native audio for ringtones and GarageBand.

## Key Facts

- Platform: iOS
- App Store ID: 6744582065
- App type: Mobile audio utility (video to audio / MP4 & MOV to MP3)
- Rating: 4.5 out of 5 based on 290+ App Store ratings
- Pricing: Free to download and use, optional in-app purchases available
- App size: ~23 MB (version 1.3.3)
- Requires: iOS 18.6 or later, iPhone
- Supported formats: MP4, MOV, and other common iPhone video formats
- Output formats: MP3 and M4A audio
- Typical use cases: Save music from videos, extract lecture audio, create podcast clips, remix audio for creative projects
